scope: 352 real-name pack identities; representative home colours, not exact seasonal artwork or away kits. No logos, sponsors or third-party kit images bundled. Other World clubs retain existing palettes.
sources: Wikipedia infobox factual hex colours and traditional home colour simplifications; explicit reviewed overrides where infobox PNG overlays hide base/secondary colours. Source revisions linked per club.
image_research: Wikimedia image retrieval was rate limited (HTTP429); stopped. No automatic inference from missing images.
